- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tokyo uses Type A power sockets, rated for 100V, 50Hz.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Most modern electronic devices like laptops, smartphones, and cameras can handle both 100V and 120V, so a voltage converter is not needed.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User will need a Type A power adapter to fit their device's plug into Japanese outlets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Type A power adapters can be purchased at electronics stores, online marketplaces, or airport gift shops.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tsukiji Outer Market still offers an incredible sushi experience despite the primary fish market moving to Toyosu Market.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should be prepared for an early start at Tsukiji Fish Market as it can get busy quickly.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should try some of the freshest sushi at Tsukiji Fish Market.
